reference_changes.process_only_safety_hooks: Message-box and cursor APIs; no account login or camera/rendering hooks.

clock_definition: Camera elapsed time is owner progress / the recovered 0.001-per-second coefficient, after setup and the initial fade. Executable launch time is excluded.

native_policy.calibration: Constant recovered-camera replay at approximately 825 Hz matches the first original run's reveal-threshold time. It preserves that measured tempo while removing render-load-dependent acceleration.

native_verification.launch: Ordinary process launch, no input, debugger or camera hooks

limitations: The original camera has no fixed total duration; its per-render feedback makes timing depend on hardware, settings and load.
These measurements used a hidden 1024x768 window and a concurrent user client/GPU workload. They do not establish a universal intended original duration.
The two original runs differ by about 6 percent. The fixed reference is a calibrated native policy, not a recovered 825 FPS cap.
This timing comparison does not establish original/native visual pixel equivalence.
